title: Atomic Chat Foundry Local Runtime Manifest
description: Schema for the release catalog of the `foundry-local` engine build: microsoft/foundry-local release archives the core installs to run ONNX Runtime GenAI models. One archive per platform, pinned by size and sha256. A published release is never rewritten; a new upstream release is a new entry. Cores skip releases whose `min_core_version` is newer than themselves or whose `c_api_version` their host does not support.

upstream_repo.description: GitHub repository the archives are downloaded from: github.com/<upstream_repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<name>.

min_core_version.description: Oldest atomic-chat-core that understands this entry. Older cores skip it.

c_api_version.description: FOUNDRY_LOCAL_API_VERSION from foundry_local_c.h of this release. A core whose host does not support it skips the release.

notes_url.description: Upstream release notes page shown next to an update offer.

platform.description: Host platform the core selects on; never derived from the asset name at runtime.
